description: This file defines the Twig template engine's token parser for 'for' loops, responsible for parsing Twig 'for' tags to create loop nodes in the template AST.

classes.name: ForTokenParser
classes.description: Final class responsible for parsing 'for' loop tags in Twig templates, producing a ForNode.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a 'for' token, processing the stream to create a ForNode representing the loop in the template AST.

methods.name: decideForFork
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates the start of an 'else' or 'endfor' block.

methods.name: decideForEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates the end of a 'for' loop.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'for', identifying this token parser for 'for' tags.
